title: fetch_public_key makes unbounded outbound HTTP on every Create activity
description: When verify_http_signatures=true, every inbound Create activity triggers an HTTP fetch to the actor's keyId URL (inbound.rs fetch_public_key). There is no caching of public keys; every article re-fetches the actor document. With N followers posting at rate R, this produces N*R outbound HTTP requests per second. An attacker posting rapidly or a slow remote server will cause request pile-up and latency spikes. The public key is stable for the lifetime of the actor; it should be cached with a TTL (similar to the JWKS cache in oidc.rs). Will cause support requests about slow AP ingestion at moderate federation scale.
